data.one_liner: PageView wrapper that supports Hero-like animations between pages
data.what_it_does: Coast acts as a PageView wrapper enabling smooth, Hero-like animations between widgets across different pages (beaches). Using Crab widgets with shared tags, items can morph and transition positions dynamically as users swipe through the view.
use_when: You need a PageView where elements animate smoothly between pages
You want Hero-like transition effects without using standard Navigator routes
avoid_when: You just need a standard un-animated PageView
You need complex navigation routing rather than page-based layouts
strengths: Provides unique Hero-like animations inside a PageView structure
Simple API utilizing Coast, Beach, and Crab widgets
weaknesses: Niche functionality limited to page-based transitions
Not documented for extensive edge cases beyond basic examples
